discovery_id.description: Stable identifier for this discovery series (updates may chain via previous_discovery_payload_sha256).

discovery_version.description: Schema version of this discovery payload.

generated_at.description: When this discovery payload was generated (best effort).

primary_domain.description: Primary official domain used for discovery (where /.well-known is served).

previous_discovery_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the previous WellKnownElectionStackDiscovery *payload* bytes (anti-rollback / anti-rewrite).

sequence.description: Optional monotonically increasing counter for operator convenience. Not authoritative without the hash chain.

pointers.description: Bounded pointers to the latest discovery anchors. Prefer digests (portable) and keep URLs stable.

official_channel_directory_payload_sha25.description: Digest of the latest OfficialChannelDirectory payload (docs/203).

public_notice_feed_payload_sha256.description: Digest of the latest PublicNoticeFeed payload (docs/200).

public_notice_signing_keyset_payload_sha.description: Optional digest of the latest PublicNoticeSigningKeyset payload (docs/208).

public_notice_feed_url.description: Stable URL where the latest PublicNoticeFeed is published.

official_channel_directory_url.description: Stable URL where the latest OfficialChannelDirectory is published.

mirror_index_url.description: Optional URL for a mirror index surface (docs/200).

keys_url.description: Optional URL for key discovery (e.g., keys.json; see docs/71).

closeout_index_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the latest PrecinctCloseoutIndex payload (docs/198).

witness_set_payload_sha256.description: Optional digest of the latest WitnessSet payload (docs/132). This bootstraps witness membership/key identity as a public surface.

witness_set_url.description: Optional stable URL where the latest WitnessSet is published (fetch convenience only; prefer digests).
